overview: One phosphatized Doushantuo specimen preserves a millimetre-scale three-tube body interpreted as sponge-grade anatomy; that affinity remains a single-specimen hypothesis.

ecology.habitat: Marine phosphorite depositional setting; life position unresolved
ecology.guild: Suspension-feeding is a sponge-grade inference, not direct evidence

evidenceSummary: SEM and tomography directly document the holotype geometry, while poriferan affinity is limited by the absence of spicules, a replicated canal system or additional specimens.

commonNameZh: 螺旋格状埃迪卡拉纪海绵候选
overview: Goblet-shaped fossils with nested quadrate grids provide an organic-skeleton body-plan test whose crown-sponge placement is a morphology-matrix result.

ecology.diet: Suspension feeding inferred from the sponge interpretation
ecology.guild: Benthic suspension feeder inferred from morphology

evidenceSummary: The figured holotype and referred material directly preserve the gridded skeleton; material composition, physiology and exact position near Hexactinellida remain interpreted.

commonNameZh: 查恩伍德分叉水螅体化石
overview: BGS GSM 105875 preserves two bifurcating polyp-like tubes with tentacle impressions in a rigid organic skeleton and tests a crown-cnidarian interpretation.

ecology.diet: Prey capture inferred from tentaculate polyps
ecology.habitat: Marine benthic setting inferred from the fossil surface
ecology.guild: Sessile tentaculate feeder inferred from anatomy

evidenceSummary: The specimen and stratigraphic context are direct observations; crown-Cnidaria placement and polyp function are morphology-based interpretations.
